## Featured Technical Content

Tests and technical proposals. Each item has a clean Markdown (`.md`) version for AI intake.

- [presentation. md](/en/apresentacao.md): **Auditable AI architecture** — Corporate AI governance, software architecture and agent systems: technical complexity translated into auditable decisions.
- [pre-access capability. md](/en/capacidade-antes-do-acesso.md): **Capacity Before Access** — teaching competence, pedagogical mediation and governance of the IA in early childhood education and initial fundamental: need, sufficiency and conditionality.
- [problem formulation. md](/en/formulacao-de-problemas.md): **Problem Formulation** — Formulating is the engineering of the reduction of uncertainty and must stop: six uncertainties, six states of knowledge, stop rule and penalty λ.
- [engineering-trust. md](/en/engenharia-confianca.md): **Trust Engineering** — Practical implementation of the Intensive Systems Model (ISM) v1.0; 4 module journey from AI-as-magic to AI-as-engineering (Silent Crash, deterministic-first, 98% surety threshold, MCP, A2UI, SDD).
- [Engineering-agents- md](/en/engenharia-agentes-ia.md): **AI Agent Engineering** — the principles of determinism: Brain × display, rigid contracts, Insurance Threshold, FinOps per ledger and MCP as border.
- [Agent-ready. md](/en/agent-ready.md): **Agent Ready** — how to make a website readable, findable and usable by AI agents: header Link (RFC 8288), content trading Markdown, Content Signals, API Catalog (RFC 9727), MCP, Agent Skills, WebMCP and the limits of an Agent Readiness score.
- [devin.md](/en/devin.md): **Vibe Coding with Devin** — from Executor to Cognitive Orchestrator: Spec-Driven Development, BDD, arsenal Skills/Playbooks/Knowledge and A2UI.
- [proposal-engineering-reverse. md](/en/proposta-engenharia-reversa.md): **Reverse Engineering Assisted by AI** — freeze As-Is with Evidence Matrix and Behavior Inventory before modernising.
- [knowledge-os-presentation. md](/en/knowledge-os-presentation.md): **Knowledge OS Enterprise** — knowledge as cognitive infrastructure governed: GraphRAG, SDD, cognitive observability, FinOps and Reuse Index.
- [salesforce-agentic-dev.md](/en/salesforce-agentic-dev.md): **Salesforce with AI Agency without technical debit** — SDD, Devin, Flosum CLI and Federated Model.
- [salesforce-agentic-quickstart. md](/en/salesforce-agentic-quickstart.md): **Quick Start Salesforce + Devin + Flosum** — from zero to deploy governed in < 60 min.
- [Devops-salesforce. md](/en/devops-salesforce.md): **DevOps for Salesforce** — governance (Flosum), code (GitHub) and autonomous speed (Devin) on the same treadmill.
- [service-operations-2-0. md](/en/service-operations-2-0.md): **Service Operations 2.0** — systemic resilience with automation, AI and agile governance.
- [support. md](/en/sustentacao.md): **From Chaos to Resilience** — support of critical systems: incidents, reliability, communication and decision.
- [socialselling. md](/en/socialselling.md): **SocialSelling** — prospecting with AI built with ADRs/SDDs, SDD-to-Code Loop, determinism and Open World.
- [proposal-observability-mobile. md](/en/proposta-observabilidade-mobile.md): **RES observability for Mobility** — end visibility with Datadog, Azure and Android Enterprise.
- [proposal. md](/en/proposta.md): **Real-Time Sales Intelligence** — Salesforce + AWS for commercial efficiency.
- [artifice. md](/en/artifice.md): **The Invisible Artificer** — sociological diagnosis of the five paradoxes that make technical mastery invisible in corporations, with self-diagnosis and antidotes.
- [terminal-evolutionary. md](/en/terminal-evolutivo.md): **Evolutionary Terminal** — the journey of Mauricio Issei (1982–2026) in scenes: the craft, the fractures that have become gold and the net that sustains.

## About This Profile

**Mauricio Yokoyama Issei** is Tech Lead with over 20 years of experience in software development, technical leadership and solution architecture.

**Main expertise areas:**
- Salesforce Administration & Development
- AWS Cloud Architecture (S3, EC2, Lambda, CodeDeploy)
- REST/SOAP & Integration Patterns APIs
- Website Reliability Engineering (SRE)
- Observability (Datadog, Splunk)
- AI Agency Design Patterns
- Data Science & Analytics

**Digital Presence:**
- LinkedIn: [linkedin. with/in/mauricioisei](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mauricioissei/)
- GitHub:[Github. with/isei](https://github.com/issei)

- Email: mauricio@issei.com.br

## How to Use This Documentation

This profile follows the **Illms. txt** standard for AI-optimized documentation:

1. **For comprehensive CV review**: Read `cv-for-ai.md`
2. **For practical examples & problem-solving**: Read `career-highlights-star.md`
3. **For structured data access**: Use JSON files in `/public/` directory
4. **For full context**: See `llms-full.txt` (concatenated version)
